claim: In the matching retail DLL, Player.TransitStateAfterAnm_Down (0x06004EC6) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 807-byte body. It loads current FormDispInfo and Ring.venueSetting, clears isTagPartnerStandby, normalizes PlDir through ChangePlayerDirToLR and applies ChangePlayerDirToLRAndReverse when raw FormRev mask 256 is set. If isKO is nonzero it clears isDownRequested, copies HP to WrsDP, selects raw BasicAnm 296 + ChangeState(17) for formIdx 100 or raw BasicAnm 297 + ChangeState(18) otherwise, then requests that animation. Otherwise it first ChangeState(10), then tests HP_Neck, HP_Arm, HP_Waist and HP_Leg in that exact order; when the tested field equals 0.0 and the corresponding SuperPain bit 1/2/4/8 is not already set, it ORs that bit, selects raw BasicAnm 354/356/358/360 respectively and SetDownTime(255). If none of the four paths is taken, the base raw BasicAnm is 180. It clears isDownRequested, copies HP to WrsDP, increments the selected animation by one when formIdx==101, requests it, and raw animations 180/181 additionally ChangeState(17/18) and set isDecDownTime=1. The shared tail tests venueSetting.ringKind==4 and Ring.IsStepOnMine(PlIdx); on true it increments stepOnMineCnt, calls Bleeding, computes 9216.0f * MatchData.mHpDamageTbl[GetHealth(HP)/2], applies AddHP of the negative scalar and ConsumeSP(9216.0f), records LastDamage and clears KoLastDamage, calls ForceSetDownTime and raises DownTime to at least 200, builds a Vector3 from PlPos.x, 0.5 and PlPos.y, selects raw effect argument 6 only when its z component is below 0, calls MatchEffect.Play_MineExplosion, then MatchMisc.PlayMatchSE(67,1.0f,PlIdx) and returns. FACT-0048 pins the only canonical caller boundary currently closed: formIdx raw 100 or 101 dispatches to this helper at IL+0x011B.
